As we all know, this garden will serve grades three through five, and the current draft proposal places it in the West Courtyard with six soil beds, one open compost tumbler, flowering plants, and a student water station, at an estimated materials cost of $3,200 from the general fund. Before I make my final decision on the design, safety plan, and funding method, I'd like to hear from each of you in your areas of expertise. Let's start with the facilities manager — could you review the proposal from your perspective?
